description: This file contains extension methods for adding startup tasks to an Orleans silo builder, enabling custom initialization logic during silo startup phases.

classes.name: SiloBuilderStartupExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods for adding startup tasks to the silo builder.

classes.name: StartupTask
classes.description: Represents a startup task participant that executes a given function during the silo lifecycle stage.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
methods.description: Overload to add a startup task by providing a startup task instance and optional stage.

methods.name: AddStartupTask
